backends.description: A just-bash shell in a Dynamic Worker. Starts fast, with no container and no direct network. Good for cat, grep, sed, awk, jq, head, tail, sort, find, text transformations, and a built-in `git` (clone, status, diff, log) that works through the workspace. Cannot run npm, node, python, or binaries outside its built-in command set.

A shell in a full Linux container: npm, node, python, package managers, test runners, and native binaries. It has no network access. Starts much more slowly than an in-Worker backend because the container must boot.

limitations: Client timing includes network round trips; samples are not latency percentiles.
The 5k and 20k fixtures are synthetic flat directories of independent TypeScript modules.

The 20k build's HTTP call failed at 301 seconds. Its compiler still ran at 346 seconds. A later diagnostic code deployment interrupted the session; the recovered execution was cancelled with exit 143. No successful 20k build duration is claimed.
The partial 20k build pull ran concurrently with the still-running compiler; it is not the total final-output sync time.
Container RSS and Worker isolate memory are different measurements. DO-filtered memory still describes an entire isolate.
GraphQL rows lag the run and are not a complete invoice.
